turns.content: Album Out Loud, hazme una carta para escuchar del álbum Cumpleaños de la abuela, para mi abuela que ya no ve bien. 4 fotos.

Album Out Loud setup. Reply go, or change any line.
1. Album or photo folder: Cumpleaños de la abuela
2. For: tu abuela, in Spanish
3. Detail: brief, one AI sentence per photo.
4. Photos: 4
5. Family notes signed by: the family
6. Letter: new

I read only this album and your earlier letters, describe the photos with the vision model of the NAS, change nothing in Photos, and save one text file after you approve. Names come only from your notes. About one minute per photo. You read the whole letter, say save, then confirm once in the approval dialog.

delegate --target photo-agent --instruction 'Read only. A ’ may be a straight apostrophe; try both. If the photo service is unhealthy, return failed and why. Use the photo folder if it is not none, otherwise the album whose name matches exactly; if several match, return at most 5 with their real UUID and photo count, and stop. Return the real name, album UUID or folder path, and photo count. If nothing matches, return no results with the closest search suggestions. Change nothing. Values: album = Cumpleaños de la abuela; photo folder = none.'

delegate --target photo-agent --instruction 'Read only. A ’ may be a straight apostrophe; try both. List still photos only, without videos and the screenshot category, paging through as many items as the photo count, sorted by capture time, oldest first. If the start time is not none, keep only photos taken after it, and leave out the already listed paths. If more remain than the limit, apply selection rule 1: keep the oldest and the newest, spread the rest evenly by position, and if a pick shares its minute with the pick before it, take the next photo in a later minute while one remains. Read their metadata in one call. Return the number kept, the newest capture time kept as year-month-day hour:minute:second, and per chosen photo, oldest first, P number, capture date and time, camera or file as its time source, the city, area or venue name or none, and the real file path. No street, house number or coordinates. Without capture times, say capture order unknown and newest time unknown. If no still photo remains, say no results. Change nothing. Values: album = Cumpleaños de la abuela; album UUID or photo folder = 9d2e4c61-0b7f-4e3a-a1c5-6f8b0d2e7a19; photo count = 6; limit = 4; start time = none; already listed = none.'

delegate --target photo-agent --instruction 'Read only. A ’ may be a straight apostrophe; try both. Use the vision-vlm action of the NAS without setting another model value, and send no photo to another service; if vision-vlm is not available, return failed. For each photo, run vision-vlm once with temperature 0.2, max tokens 90 and this prompt, copied exactly. Prompt begins: You write the spoken description of one family photo for a listener who is blind. Step 1, privacy: if the photo shows an ID card, a bank card, a medical paper, a medical scene, an injury, a bare body, or a phone or computer screen with messages or personal data, write only Not described: and a reason of at most 4 words in Spanish, and nothing else. Step 2, otherwise write exactly two lines and nothing more. Line 1: one sentence in Spanish of 8 to 12 words that starts with the main subject and says what is happening. Line 2: Words: and then the large, clear text that is a main part of the photo, such as a sign, a banner, writing on a cake or a printed shirt, copied letter by letter in its own language and spelling, at most 25 words, or Words: none. Leave out small print, bottle and food labels, logos, watermarks, number plates and any number longer than 4 digits, and never translate. For people, give the number up to 5, otherwise say a group, call each one a baby, a child or an adult, never man, woman, boy, girl, he or she, and give their main visible action. In a language with gendered words, use the same form for every adult whatever they look like, such as un adulto in Spanish. Never mention a name, ethnicity, skin, body, looks, age in years, health, disability or religion, and never guess who someone is, how they are related, such as a family or a couple, or what they feel. If the figures are statues, toys, drawings or pictures, say so first, such as a bronze statue of two children. Name an event only when clear objects show it, such as candles on a cake or graduation gowns. If the photo is black and white or an old print, begin Line 1 with the words In black and white or An old print, said in Spanish, never with this photo shows. If the whole photo is too dark or too blurred to see, Line 1 says only that, in Spanish, Line 2 is Words: none, and you guess nothing. Never begin with this photo shows, the image or a picture of. Keep the labels Line 1, Line 2, Words, none and Not described in English. Use no quotation marks, no apostrophes and, in English, no contractions. Prompt ends. If the answer has a Words line, with or without a Line 2 or Line 3 label, that is not Words: none, also run vision-ocr on that photo. Return one record per photo in order: P number, every answer line word for word, and the vision-ocr result or none. If vision-vlm fails on a photo, return its P number, Not described and why. Never describe a photo yourself. How to read it: Each photo starts with its number, for example Photo 1 of 4. Lines that start with Family says are from the family. Lines that start with AI guess come from a computer on our home NAS and may be wrong.

Photo 4 of 4.

This photo was not described. Reason: documento de identidad personal.

What this letter cannot tell you: AI guesses can be wrong. Names and relationships come only from the family. Photos that were not described, and anything a photo cannot show, are for the family to tell you. The last part of this letter is a file list for the helper; you can stop listening here.
